chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0279 — The Dao-Companion’s Farewell
chapter_meta_description: Nine Lotos cannot abandon her clan. Ji Ning cannot stay. In a brutal farewell, their Dao-Heart paths diverge forever. A chapter of devastating choices and new resolve.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0279 — The Dao-Companion’s Farewell
og_description: Ji Ning asks Nine Lotos to walk his perilous path — and she cannot say yes. A heart-wrenching parting sets him on a lonely, dangerous road.
twitter_description: Ji Ning and Nine Lotos part ways. A heartbreaking choice between clan loyalty and love.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare secret art that allows a cultivator to scry past events. The Shao clan possesses this ability, which is why Ji Ning knows his window of safety is nearly zero.
A Grand Xia Dynasty-wide tournament for young prodigies to showcase their talent. Top performers gain patronage from the most powerful factions in the realm.

The elite military force directly under the Grand Xia royal clan. Its headquarters are considered absolute safe territory, as even the largest clan would not dare attack a cultivator within its walls.
A supreme clan in the Grand Xia Dynasty that rivals and exceeds the Shao clan. They are locked in a death feud that has raged since the Primordial Fiendgod Era.

A cultivation partner whose Dao-heart and life-path are fully intertwined. True Dao-companions would sacrifice everything — even their own lives — for each other. Nine Lotos admits she cannot meet this standard.
The ancient epoch before the current Three Realms were formed, when primordial Fiendgods roamed the chaos. Feuds that began in this era are considered eternal blood debts.
